name: Spot Zero
description:
About This Game

Spot Zero is a mission-driven anime action RPG where you lead a squad of Human and Yokai investigators to break through monster-controlled zones, secure new outposts, and push the frontline outward. Each character brings a distinct combat style, blade clashes, parry waves, grappling hooks, TPS mode and elemental bursts, as you uncover the truth behind the world’s downfall.

World Overview

After the arrival of the Abyssal Gods, cities fell and nations vanished. Only scattered towns built by Humans and Yokai remain, fragile bastions standing against an endless tide of monsters.
While these last sanctuaries fight to survive, the Investigation Corps ventures into the unknown, mapping hostile territories, cutting through monster-controlled zones, and assembling outposts to reclaim the land inch by inch.

You are the Corps’ Mentor, tasked with training elite investigators, organizing their missions, and leading them into the heart of the crisis in search of the truth behind the world’s collapse.


Lead a squad of Human and Yokai investigators

Train, manage, and deploy a diverse team of Human and Yokai fighters, each carrying unique abilities and personalities. As the Corps’ Mentor, you coordinate missions, prepare your squad, and guide them through operations that determine the fate of the remaining survivors.

Experience high-impact combat with unique character styles

Every character fights differently, whether it’s blade clashes, parry waves, grappling-hook mobility, precise TPS aiming, or elemental bursts. Swap between investigators and create fluid, fast-paced combat chains tailored to each mission’s challenges.

Unleash the Spot Zero Domain for squad-wide power

Charge team energy to activate the Spot Zero Domain, freezing enemy time and bringing your entire squad onto the battlefield. Enter a match-3 tactical mode, build combo energy, and unleash devastating fusion skills based on your score and elemental composition.

Face massive bosses with dynamic weak-point systems

Battle towering monsters with breakable weak points, stagger windows, arena interactions, and multi-phase mechanics. Learn each boss’s patterns and exploit their vulnerabilities to shatter limbs, disrupt attacks, and turn the tide.

Your Destiny Awaits

Every outpost you claim brings you closer to the source of the invasion. Lead your squad, carve a path through the frontline, and uncover the truth that will decide the world’s last hope.
